Iowa: what's on the November 3, 2026 ballot

Every candidate below is listed alphabetically, with party shown as text only. Open a name for their stated positions, background and recent news, each with sources.

Open Iowa on the map

Key dates

  • In-person absentee (early) voting: October 14, 2026 to November 2, 2026. Early voting is at county auditor's offices, and some counties have extra sites. Hours vary by county.
  • Voter pre-registration deadline: October 19, 2026. The deadline is 5:00 p.m. You can also register at early voting or at your polling place on Election Day if you show proof of identity and residence.
  • Last day to request a mail absentee ballot: October 19, 2026. Your county auditor must receive the request by 5:00 p.m. Mailed ballots must be received by 8:00 p.m. on Election Day.
  • Election Day: November 3, 2026. Polls are open 7 a.m. to 8 p.m.

Official election information: vote.gov

Who's running

Only the U.S. Senate and governor races are loaded so far. Other statewide offices, ballot measures, U.S. House and local races aren't loaded yet. Check your sample ballot for the full list.
